chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you depart for Arafat, say while you are heading towards it: 'O Allah, to You I have turned, and upon You I have relied, and Your Face is what I intend. Therefore, I ask You to bless my journey, fulfill my needs, and make me among those whom You boast about to those who are superior to me.'

Then proclaim the Talbiyya while you are going to Arafat. When you arrive at Arafat, strike your tent at Namira; and Namira is the bottom of Uraynah, before the standing place and before Arafat. When the sun declines on the Day of Arafat, perform ghusl and pray Dhuhr and Asr with one Adhan and two Iqamas. You hasten Asr and combine the two prayers to free yourself for supplication, for it is a day of supplication and asking.
He (peace be upon him) said: 'And the boundary of Arafat is from the bottom of Uraynah and Thawiyya and Namira to Dhi al-Majaz; and behind the mountain is the standing place.'

key_terms.أَذَانٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ إِقَامَتَيْنِ: One Adhan (call to prayer) and two Iqamas (call to stand for prayer), indicating the method of combining prayers
key_terms.الدُّعَاءِ: Supplication, a central act of worship on this day
key_terms.الظُّهْرَ وَ الْعَصْرَ: Dhuhr and Asr, the noon and afternoon prayers
key_terms.الْمَوْقِفِ: The standing place, referring to the ritual station of Wuquf at Arafat
key_terms.تُلَبِّ: To proclaim the Talbiyya (the ritual declaration of readiness to serve God)
key_terms.عَرَفَةَ: Arafat, the sacred plain where the main standing (wuquf) of Hajj occurs
key_terms.نَمِرَةَ: Namira, a specific location within the Arafat plain where the Prophet's tent was set up

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended supplications and prayer methods for the Day of Arafat according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific rituals of the Day of Arafat, emphasizing the spiritual preparation through a dedicated supplication upon departure and the strategic combination of Dhuhr and Asr prayers to maximize time for devotion. It highlights the significance of Namira as the focal point for these rites and defines the geographical boundaries of the Arafat plain, reflecting the scholarly tradition of linking physical movement with spiritual intent during Hajj.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Safwan Bin Yahya, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When you go in the morning to Arafaat, so say, while you are diverting towards it, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! To You<sup>azwj</sup> I have turned, and upon You<sup>saww</sup> I have relied, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Face is what I intend. Therefore, I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> that You<sup>azwj</sup> Bless me in my journey, and Fulfill my needs for me, and if You<sup>azwj</sup> were to Make me today, to be from the ones You<sup>azwj</sup> would Boast with to the one who is superior than me’.

Then exclaim Talbiyya while you are going to Arafaat. So when you end up to Arafaat, so strike your tent at Namra; and Namra, it is in the middle of Urna besides the Pausing Station and besides Arafaat. So when the sun (starts to) decline on the Day of Arafaat, so wash and Pray Al-Zohr, and Al-Asr with one Azaan and two Iqamaas; and rather you should hasten Al-Asr and gather between the two in order to unload yourself for the supplication, for it is a day of supplication and asking’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And a boundary of Arafaat is from the middle of Urna and Sawiyya and Namra up to Zil Majaaz; and behind the mountain is the Pausing Station’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya and ibn abu ‘Umayr Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When in the morning you are ready to move toward ‘Arafat, say this prayer, ‘O Lord, I have turned to You, depend on You and for Your sake I act. I appeal before You to make my journey a blessing, grant my needs and make me today of those about whom You express pride before those who are more virtuous than I am.’

Thereafter say Talbiyah and you are on your way to ‘Arafat. You can pitch up your tent in Namirah when you arrive in ‘Arafat, which is before the station and before ‘Arafat. On the day of ‘Arafah, take Ghusl (bath) when it is Zawal (declining of the sun toward the west at noontime). You can perform al-Zuhr and al-‘Asr Salat (prayer) with one Adhan and two ‘Iqamah. Say al-‘Asr Salat (prayer) earlier, in fact perform them soon one after the other, so you can give yourself enough time for prayer and supplication; it is the day for appealing and pleading (before Allah).’
He (the Imam) said, ‘The boundaries of ‘Arafat are from Batn ‘Urnah, to Thawiyah, and Namirah to Dhil Majaz. Behind the hill is the station.’”
